title: Rapture SMP Modpack
description: Rapture SMP's Official modpack! Rapture is a SMP all about exploring possible apocalyptic scenarios every season! We offer a new modpack every season.
body: Rapture SMP is a minecraft server about apocalyptic scenerios, every season explores different themes and all the lore is overarching, what happens in a prior season is cemented in the official lore. Make your story known by joining our community!
